title: 乙太網路交換器
summary: 以L2 學習、VLAN 與有限交換容量連結 16 個技術單元，新增 32 步原理、架構、假想算例、實驗設計與失效驗證。
summaryEn: Sixteen technical units connect l2 learning, vlans and finite switching capacity through 32 new tasks covering principles, architecture, assumed calculations, experiment design and failure validation.
scope: 公開原理的雙語工程教育；工作臺是概念模擬，不是特定廠商產品的完整模擬器。數值為自行設定的教學假設。實驗僅限離線模型、自己的隔離環境或明確授權的測試資料；不掃描或改動真實第三方系統，未測平臺保留未決。
scopeEn: Bilingual engineering education from public principles; the workbench is a conceptual simulation, not a complete simulator of any vendor product. Inputs are original teaching assumptions. Experiments use offline models, owned isolated environments or explicitly authorized test data, never scan/modify third-party systems and leave untested platforms unresolved.

stages.title: 框架與學習
stages.description: 四個技術單元以原理／架構與實驗／驗證兩步完成「框架與學習」；每步獨立保存進度與知識測驗。
stages.descriptionEn: Four technical units develop frames and learning through separate principle/architecture and experiment/validation tasks with saved progress and knowledge checks.

steps.title: 框架欄位：原理與架構
steps.objective: 以「框架欄位」建立可檢查的架構、原理與驗證依據。
steps.objectiveEn: Establish reviewable architecture, principles and evidence for frame fields.
steps.instruction: 先觀看師傅示意，辨識「框架欄位」的資料、控制與時間關係。來源與目的 MAC 屬於框架而非 IP 路由。 在離線工作臺畫出元件／資料流，列出輸入、輸出、保存狀態與合法轉移；建立基準與擾動兩種假想情境，寫下可被反駁的預測。以「分類 L2 與 L3 位址。」設計下一步驗證。記錄版本、單位、未知參數與模型外的行為。
steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for frame fields. Source/destination MACs belong to frames, not IP routes. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Classify L2 and L3 addresses. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.
steps.observation: 分類 L2 與 L3 位址。
steps.failure: 常見誤判：VLAN 是所有應用授權的充分證據。 本步需分開功能正確、資源上界與證據範圍，不可把假想結果當作真實平臺保證。
steps.failureEn: Common mistake: VLAN membership proves all application authorization. Separate correctness, resource bounds and evidence scope; hypothetical results are not real-platform guarantees.
steps.check: 提交「框架欄位」的兩情境架構／狀態圖、參數表與可反駁預測；標出哪些資料支援「來源與目的 MAC 屬於框架而非 IP 路由。」。
steps.checkEn: Submit frame fields two-case architecture/state diagrams, parameter table and falsifiable prediction; identify evidence supporting the principle.

knowledge.title: 框架欄位的原理與邊界
knowledge.text: 來源與目的 MAC 屬於框架而非 IP 路由。
knowledge.textEn: Source/destination MACs belong to frames, not IP routes.

knowledge.title: 框架欄位的驗證設計
knowledge.text: 分類 L2 與 L3 位址。 保留基準與擾動的完整輸入／輸出，以語義、容量或時間條件檢查，並明列假想模型未涵蓋的現實因素。
knowledge.textEn: Classify L2 and L3 addresses. Retain complete inputs/outputs for baseline and perturbation, check semantic/capacity/timing criteria and state real-world factors omitted from the hypothetical model.

knowledge.title: 本課原創量化算例
knowledge.text: 假設 10 Gb/s Ethernet 最小框架 64 B，另計 8 B preamble/SFD 與 12 B IFG，每框架線路佔用 84 B，理想為 10¹⁰/(84×8)≈14.881 Mframes/s；VLAN 與不同框架長度需重算。
knowledge.textEn: At assumed 10 Gb/s, a 64 B minimum frame plus 8 B preamble/SFD and 12 B IFG occupies 84 B: about 14.881 Mframes/s ideal. VLAN and other frame sizes need recalculation.

quiz.question: 本步審查「框架欄位」與整體「乙太網路交換器」時，哪項陳述或驗證有依據？
quiz.questionEn: When reviewing frame fields within ethernet switches, which statement or check is supported?
options: 來源與目的 MAC 屬於框架而非 IP 路由。
VLAN 是所有應用授權的充分證據。
緩衝增加就能長期突破出口頻寬。
optionsEn: Source/destination MACs belong to frames, not IP routes.
VLAN membership proves all application authorization.
More buffers permanently exceed egress bandwidth.
quiz.explanation: 來源與目的 MAC 屬於框架而非 IP 路由。 分類 L2 與 L3 位址。 其餘選項混淆不同架構或證據的適用邊界。
quiz.explanationEn: Source/destination MACs belong to frames, not IP routes. Classify L2 and L3 addresses. The alternatives confuse architectural or evidence boundaries.

steps.title: 框架欄位：實驗與驗證
steps.objective: 用「分類 L2 與 L3 位址。」檢查「框架欄位」的假設、結果及失效邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Validate assumptions, outcomes and failure boundaries for frame fields using the specified experiment.
steps.instruction: 重播師傅對「框架欄位」的示範，在自己的隔離模型或試算表執行：分類 L2 與 L3 位址。 核對「來源與目的 MAC 屬於框架而非 IP 路由。」是否成立；保留輸入、預期、實際結果與差異。至少提出兩個競爭原因，選擇一項能區分它們的新增觀察。依事前定義的語義、容量或延遲條件判斷通過／保留，未執行的真實平臺項目不得標為實測。
steps.instructionEn: Replay the mentor for frame fields and execute in your own isolated model or worksheet: Classify L2 and L3 addresses. Check the principle: Source/destination MACs belong to frames, not IP routes. Preserve input, expected output, observed output and differences. Propose two competing causes and a discriminating observation. Apply predefined semantic, capacity or latency criteria and mark untested real-platform claims unresolved.
steps.observation: 分類 L2 與 L3 位址。
steps.failure: 常見誤判：VLAN 是所有應用授權的充分證據。 本步需分開功能正確、資源上界與證據範圍，不可把假想結果當作真實平臺保證。
steps.failureEn: Common mistake: VLAN membership proves all application authorization. Separate correctness, resource bounds and evidence scope; hypothetical results are not real-platform guarantees.
steps.check: 提交「框架欄位」的輸入與結果對照、競爭原因、接受／保留理由；逐項說明「分類 L2 與 L3 位址。」的證據與尚未驗證範圍。
steps.checkEn: Submit frame fields input/output comparisons, competing causes and pass/hold rationale; state evidence and untested scope for the experiment.
